description: This Dart file defines the TagsPage widget, a Flutter widget for managing tags within a task management app. It includes UI for listing tags, creating new tags, editing, and deleting tags with confirmation dialogs and bottom sheets for actions.

classes.name: TagsPage
classes.description: A Flutter widget for displaying and managing a list of tags, allowing creation, editing, and deletion with confirmation dialogs and contextual menus.

methods.name: _openCreate
methods.description: Navigates to the TagFormPage to create a new tag.

methods.name: _openEdit
methods.description: Navigates to the TagFormPage to edit an existing tag.

methods.name: _showTagMenu
methods.description: Displays a bottom sheet menu with options to edit or delete a specific tag.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Shows a confirmation dialog for deleting a tag and performs the deletion, updating tasks that reference the tag, with user feedback.
